description: This file contains the OrganizationService class which provides methods for managing organization information within the OrangeHRM system. It acts as a service layer interfacing with the OrganizationDao data access object to retrieve and save organization data.

classes.name: OrganizationService
classes.description: Provides functions to retrieve and update organization general information, encapsulating data access via the OrganizationDao.

methods.name: getOrganizationDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the OrganizationDao instance used within this service.

methods.name: setOrganizationDao
methods.description: Setter method to inject a specific OrganizationDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Retrieves the general information of the organization via the DAO.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Saves the provided Organization object to the database via the DAO, may throw TransactionException.
